scope: Guarded local snapshot reader and policy-admission development validation; engine/cluster integration is separate
test_command: GOMAXPROCS=1 GOPROXY=off GOTOOLCHAIN=local go test -p 1 -race -mod=readonly -modfile=artifacts/guards.mod -tags duckdb_arrow,duckbridge ./internal/federation ./internal/access -count=1 -timeout=4m -json
limitations: Direct unit/race validation only; not throughput or production acceptance
Integrity hashing rereads whole parts at discovery and each scan
Decoder counter excludes guard/result allocations and process memory

retained_prior_failures.finding: Pinned Arrow record-reader constructor spawned background goroutines even with Parallel false; decoder cap panic escaped recovery
retained_prior_failures.resolution: Use public sequential column readers; cap, partial-allocation cap and panic cleanup controls pass
